settings.filesize: The maximum file size allowed is 200 kB.
settings.scanphotosdescription: Scan for new files on your library

scannextclouddescription.item1: Make a list of all files in subdirectories. For each media file:
scannextclouddescription.item2: If the filepath exists, check if the file has been modified. If it was modified, rescan the image. If not, we skip.
scannextclouddescription.item3: Calculate a unique ID of the image file (MD5)
scannextclouddescription.item4: If this media file is already in the database, we add the path to the existing media file.
scannextclouddescription.item8: Reverse geolocate to get location names from GPS coordinates
scannextclouddescription.item10: Add photo to thing and place albums.
scannextclouddescription.item11: Check if photos are missing or have been moved.

settings.missingphotosdescription: On every scan LibrePhotos will check if the files are still in the same location or if they have been moved. If they are missing, then they get marked as such.
settings.eventsalbumsdescription: The backend server will first group photos by time taken. If two consecutive photos are taken within 12 hours of each other, the two photos are considered to be from the same event. After groups are put together in this way, it automatically generates a title for this album.
settings.eventalbumsregeneratedescription: Automatically generated albums have names of people in the titles. If you trained your face classifier after making event albums, you can generate new titles for already existing event albums to reflect the new names associated with the faces in photos.
settings.trainfacesdescription: Teach the system based on existing info
settings.rescanfacesdescription: Look for faces on the library
settings.ocrdescription: Read the text on your photos so that you can search for it. Only photos that have not been processed yet are read.
settings.ocrdisabled: Choose a text recognition model in the admin area to enable this.
settings.ocrfullbutton: Extract text again for all photos
settings.captionsdescription: Write a short caption for each photo that has none, so you can search for what is in it. Captions you wrote yourself are never changed.

settings.reapplydaterulestitle: Apply date rules to existing photos
settings.reapplydaterulesdescription: Reads the date of every photo again with your current date rules, and moves photos to their new day. A date you set by hand is never changed. Generate event albums afterwards so they follow the new dates.
settings.daterulesoffer: Photos scanned from now on use them. Apply them to the photos already in your library too? A date you set by hand is never changed.

semanticsearch.description: How many photos a search adds because they look like the search text. Disabled searches by text only.

settings.favoriteminimum: Minimum image rating to interpret as favorite

ratingstyledescription.favorite: Mark photos with a favorite star. Adding a favorite sets the photo's rating to the minimum rating below; removing a favorite sets it to 0, which also clears a star rating the photo had.
ratingstyledescription.stars: Rate photos with 1 to 5 stars in the photo viewer (keys 0 to 5) and in the selection menu. A rating only changes when you set it. The minimum rating below still decides which photos are favorites.

burst.description: Configure how burst sequences are detected. Hard criteria use EXIF data and filename patterns (reliable), while soft criteria use timestamp proximity and visual similarity (estimation).

videoerror.format: The file arrived intact, so this is a format your browser cannot decode. Turning on "Always transcode videos" in your settings will convert it as it plays.
videoerror.formatconverted: Your browser cannot decode this video, and converting it for playback failed too. The server log has the reason the conversion stopped.
videoerror.missingtitle: This file is no longer on disk
videoerror.missing: The library still lists this video, but the file itself is gone - moved, renamed or deleted since the last scan.
videoerror.permissiontitle: The server cannot read this file
videoerror.permissionuser: The video is in your library, but the server was refused access to the file on disk. That is a permissions problem on the server, not a problem with the video - please ask your administrator to look into it.
videoerror.permissionadmin: The web server was refused access to the file on disk. Originals are served straight from the library by the web server, which runs as a far less privileged user than the scanner - so a video that was indexed and thumbnailed correctly can still be impossible to play.
videoerror.servertitle: The server could not deliver this video
videoerror.server: The server answered with an error ({{status}}). The backend log will say why.
videoerror.session: Sign in again to keep watching.
videoerror.blockeddirectory: The web server cannot enter this directory:
videoerror.blockedfile: The web server cannot read this file:
videoerror.webserverids: The web server reads files as {{uid}}:{{gid}}.
videoerror.filesystem: This path is on a {{type}} filesystem mounted at {{point}}.
videoerror.remedychmod: It is a local filesystem, so the mode bits are the fix: give the web server read access along the whole path with chmod o+rX (directories need o+x, files o+r).
videoerror.remedymountoptions: On this filesystem the permissions come from the mount, not from the files - chmod will look like it worked and change nothing. Set uid=, gid=, file_mode=, dir_mode= (or umask=, fmask=, dmask=) in the mount options or the fstab entry instead.
videoerror.remedymountdeeper: What is closed is the library root itself, or something above it. Rather than opening up a directory that has good reason to stay private, mount the photo folders directly into the data root.
videoerror.remedyreadonly: This mount is read-only, so any permission change will fail until it is remounted read-write.
videoerror.remedynetworkfs: This is a network filesystem, so permissions are decided on the machine that exports it - a local chmod may be squashed or ignored.
videoerror.remedylabels: The mode bits along this path already let the web server read the file, so permissions are not the problem. Look instead at SELinux or AppArmor labelling (a bind mount may need :z or :Z), a container runtime that remaps user ids, or a rebuilt proxy image whose web server does not run as the ids above.

videoerror.formatnoconversion: The file arrived intact, so this is a format your browser cannot decode, and it cannot be converted for playback here. Try opening it in a different browser.

sitesettings.headerautocreateuserdirectory: Create a folder for each new user
sitesettings.autocreateuserdirectory: New users get their own folder under the data root as their scan directory. Your own scan directory must be a subfolder, not the data root itself, because scan directories of different users cannot overlap.
sitesettings.scanmissingmaxfraction: A scan changes nothing and asks whether the library is mounted when more than this share of a user's photos, and more than 100 photos, would be marked missing. 100% turns the check off.
sitesettings.autoscandescription: Scans every library for new and changed files, like the Scan button on the Library page, Nextcloud folders included while that integration is on. A user whose scan is still running is skipped, so scans never pile up.
sitesettings.autoscantimezone: The time is in the server's time zone, {{zone}}.

sitesettings.headertrashretention: Delete photos from the trash after
sitesettings.trashretention: Days a photo stays in a user's trash before it is deleted for good. 0 keeps photos in the trash until the user empties it.
sitesettings.trashretentionwarningtitle: Original files are deleted from disk
sitesettings.trashretentionwarning_one: Every day, photos that have been in any user's trash for more than {{count}} day are deleted together with their files in the scan directory. Nobody is asked first.
sitesettings.trashretentionwarning_other: Every day, photos that have been in any user's trash for more than {{count}} days are deleted together with their files in the scan directory. Nobody is asked first.
sitesettings.trashretentionconfirmtitle: Delete old photos from the trash automatically?
sitesettings.trashretentionconfirm_one: Photos that have been in a trash for more than {{count}} day will be deleted for good, with their original files.
sitesettings.trashretentionconfirm_other: Photos that have been in a trash for more than {{count}} days will be deleted for good, with their original files.
sitesettings.trashretentionaffected_one: Right now that is {{count}} photo ({{users}}), deleted at the next daily cleanup.
sitesettings.trashretentionaffected_other: Right now that is {{count}} photos ({{users}}), deleted at the next daily cleanup.
sitesettings.trashretentionnone: Right now no photo has been in a trash that long, so the next cleanup deletes nothing.
sitesettings.trashretentioncounting: Counting the photos this would delete
sitesettings.trashretentioncountfailed: The photos this would delete could not be counted.
sitesettings.skippatterns: Comma delimited list of patterns to ignore (e.g. '@eaDir,#recycle' for Synology devices)
sitesettings.map_api_provider_description: Turns the GPS position of a photo into a place name. ExifTool works offline and names the nearest town; online providers can name streets, but receive your photos' coordinates. Switching renames nothing already named: run Look up place names again in Admin Tools afterwards.
sitesettings.map_tile_provider_description: Where the map background is loaded from. Opening a map reveals your photos' approximate location to this provider. Choose "None" to disable maps entirely.
sitesettings.heavyweight: Increase the number of picture-scanning workers beyond 1, but be prepared to use 800 MB memory for each additional one.
sitesettings.captioning_model_description: Select a model for generating image captions.
sitesettings.heavyweight_process_warning: Setting the number of heavyweight processes to more than 3 will likely require more than 16GB of RAM. Please consider this before proceeding.
sitesettings.face_recognition_model_description: Select the InsightFace model pack used for face recognition. Larger models are more accurate but require more resources.
sitesettings.ocr_model_description: Extracts readable text from your photos into the database so that it becomes searchable. This includes text on documents, receipts and IDs. Choose "None" to keep OCR off.
sitesettings.ocr_warning: Text recognition stores all readable text of every photo in the database as plain text. That includes documents, receipts, letters and IDs that happen to be in your library. Larger models are more accurate, but need more time and memory per photo.
sitesettings.features_description: Switch off what you do not need to make scans faster. Turning a feature off keeps everything it already made: faces, names, captions, Things and place names stay.
sitesettings.feature_face_detection_description: Finds faces in new photos, so you can name people.
sitesettings.feature_face_detection_off: Off: new photos are not checked for faces.
sitesettings.feature_face_cluster_description: Groups unnamed faces that look alike, so you can name them together.
sitesettings.feature_face_cluster_off: Off: unnamed faces are not grouped.
sitesettings.feature_image_captioning_description: Writes a short description of each new photo.
sitesettings.feature_image_captioning_off: Off: new photos get no caption.
sitesettings.feature_scene_classification_description: Labels what is in each photo, such as beach or dog, for the Things albums.
sitesettings.feature_scene_classification_off: Off: new photos get no Things.
sitesettings.feature_reverse_geocoding_description: Looks up the place name for a photo's GPS position with the map provider.
sitesettings.feature_reverse_geocoding_off: Off: new photos keep their coordinates but get no place name.
sitesettings.feature_video_previews_description: Plays a short silent clip of each video in the photo grid.
sitesettings.feature_video_previews_off: Off: the grid shows a still frame, and scans skip encoding the clip, the slowest step of importing a video.
sitesettings.feature_video_previews_existing: Videos that already have an animated preview keep it until they are rescanned; new videos get a still frame.
sitesettings.feature_locked_description: Turned off by the server configuration: {{variable}}=false. Change it in your compose or .env file and restart to use it.
sitesettings.feature_model_missing: Model not downloaded yet. It downloads before the next scan.

allmetadata.footer: Read from the files just now with ExifTool. Nothing is stored. Only you see this.

updating.title: LibrePhotos is updating
updating.text: Your photos are safe. This can take a few minutes on large libraries. This page reloads by itself.

starting.title: LibrePhotos is starting
starting.text: LibrePhotos is starting its services. This usually takes a few seconds, and this page reloads by itself.

unreachable.title: LibrePhotos is not answering
unreachable.text: The server may be restarting. Your photos are safe. This page tries again every few seconds and reloads by itself.
unreachable.long: Still no answer. If you run this server, check that the backend container or the Windows app is running.

backendStatus.slow: Still working? Large libraries can take longer. If nothing changes for an hour, ask the person who set up LibrePhotos to look at the log.

E001.title: This LibrePhotos is too old to update in one step
E001.text: Your photos and settings are unchanged. Install version 1.1.0 first, start it once, then update again.
E001.details: The database is older than LibrePhotos 2026w10, the oldest release this version can update from (reason code E001).

E002.title: This database belongs to a newer LibrePhotos
E002.text: Your photos and settings are unchanged. The database was already updated by a newer release. Install that release or a newer one again.
E002.details: A newer LibrePhotos release has already updated this database, and this older release cannot run on it (reason code E002).

unknown.title: The update could not finish
unknown.text: LibrePhotos did not start. Your photos are unchanged. The reason is in the logs folder: command_migrate.log (Docker) or console.log (Windows app).
unknown.details: The database update stopped with an error. The log named above says which step failed and why.

backendStatus.detailsTitle: For the person who runs this server

upgradetasks.intro: This update left a few things to do once. Automatic tasks run by themselves; you can follow them here or in the job list.
upgradetasks.finishedintro: Everything the update left to do is done. This card goes away tomorrow.
upgradetasks.waiting: Waiting for the running job to finish
upgradetasks.failednoreason: The last run did not finish.

unknown.title: Another task from the update ({{key}})
unknown.description: Start it to finish the update.

semantic_search_conversion.title: Update search for the new search model
semantic_search_conversion.description: Search results may be incomplete until this finishes. Your photos are not changed.

strip_thumbnail_metadata.title: Remove photo details from old thumbnails
strip_thumbnail_metadata.description: Thumbnails made by LibrePhotos 1.2.1 or older still contain details from the original photo, such as where it was taken. Your photos are not changed.

refresh_exposure_times.title: Read shutter speeds again
refresh_exposure_times.description: LibrePhotos 1.3.0 and older stored some shutter speeds wrongly, such as 0 for very short ones. This reads them again from your photos. Your photos are not changed.

probe_videos.title: Read colour information of older videos
probe_videos.titlecount_one: Read colour information of {{count}} older video
probe_videos.titlecount_other: Read colour information of {{count}} older videos
probe_videos.description: So HDR videos play with the right colours and get new thumbnails. Your videos are not changed.

movephotos.title: Move to another folder
movephotos.destinationhint: A folder of your library. A new folder is made when the photos move.
movephotos.pickfolder: Pick a folder of your library.
movephotos.absolutepath: Enter the full path of the folder, as the tree shows it.
movephotos.foldername: Enter a name for the folder.
movephotos.badfoldername: A folder name has no / or \ and does not start with a dot.
movephotos.pickparent: Pick the folder to make it in first.
movephotos.checkfailed: The folder could not be checked.
movephotos.folderrefused: This folder cannot take the photos.
movephotos.nothingtomove: None of the selected photos can move here.
movephotos.filesnote: RAW files, Live Photo videos and XMP sidecars move with their photo. Nothing in the folder is overwritten.
movephotos.unchanged_one: {{count}} photo is already in this folder.
movephotos.unchanged_other: {{count}} photos are already in this folder.
movephotos.clashes_one: {{count}} photo has a name that is taken in this folder: you choose what to do next.
movephotos.clashes_other: {{count}} photos have a name that is taken in this folder: you choose what to do next.

refused.nextcloud_one: {{count}} photo is a copy of a Nextcloud file and stays where it is.
refused.nextcloud_other: {{count}} photos are copies of Nextcloud files and stay where they are.
refused.shared_file_one: {{count}} photo shares a file with another photo and stays where it is.
refused.shared_file_other: {{count}} photos share a file with another photo and stay where they are.
refused.not_on_disk_one: {{count}} photo has no files on disk and stays where it is.
refused.not_on_disk_other: {{count}} photos have no files on disk and stay where they are.

movephotos.listfailed: The folders could not be read.
movephotos.truncated: More folders are not shown. Type the path above.
movephotos.nolibrary: You have no library folder yet. An admin sets your scan directory.
movephotos.conflictintro_one: The folder already has a file with the name of this photo.
movephotos.conflictintro_other: The folder already has files with the names of these {{count}} photos.
movephotos.renamehint: Rename, keep both: the moved photo gets a free name, such as IMG_1 (1).jpg, for all its files.
movephotos.skiphint_one: Skip: this photo stays where it is.
movephotos.skiphint_other: Skip: these {{count}} photos stay where they are.
